newsitem.title: USA: Commodore Applied names top executives.
newsitem.headline: Commodore Applied names top executives.

text.p: Commodore Applied Technologies Inc said on Wednesday it has named Thomas Noel as president and chief executive officer, effective October 1, 1996, replacing Paul Hannesson who will become chairman.
Hannesson will succeed Bentley Blum, the company's majority shareholder who will remain on the board, the company said.
Noel is presently president of TransAmerican Waste Industries Inc, Commodore said.
Commodore is 72-percent owned by Commodore Environmental Services Inc.
